स्थ स्थ (vb. स्था), adj. Staying, abiding; e. g. गर्भ-, Being in the womb, Hit. pr. d. 27, M.M. जन-, adj. Living amongst men, Bhāg. P. 7, 15, 56. जल-, adj. Existing in water, Rām. 4, 13, 10. तट-, adj.
 1. Standing on the shore.
 2. Indifferent, Utt. Rāmac. 60, 2. दूर-, adj. Standing aloof, Man. 2, 202. भू-तल-, adj. Standing, being on the surface of the earth, Pañc. 106, 6. यौवन-, adj., f. था, Marriageable, Sāv. 1, 22.

स्था स्था, i. 1, तिष्ठ, Par., and in some significations only Ātm., but in epic poetry Ātm. as well as Par., against the rules of the Gramm.
 1. To stand, Hit. i. d. 97; with जानुभ्याम्, To kneel, Vikr. 63, 6; with शासने, To obey, Vikr. d. 155.
 2. To cease to move, to stand still, to stop, Vikr. d. 20; Rām. 1, 60, 19; to wait, Vikr. 88, 17; to be restrained, Man. 7, 108.
 3. To stay, MBh. 2, 732; to abide, Man. 7, 37 (शासने, He may abide by their decision).
 --Impers. pass., Hit. 46, 2, M.M.; Lass. 56, 2, स्थीयताम्, It may be abided, viz. by you, i. e. you may abide.
 4. With instr. To practise, to use what the instrumental expresses, Pañc. 31, 18 (सामादिभिस्, To use conciliatory speech, etc.); 76, 20 (मौनव्रतेन, To be silent).
 5. To be, Man. 8, 158; to exist, Man. 7, 8.
 6. To remain, Lass. 51, 25; [] Man. 4, 111; to stand at one's side, Hit. i. d. 72, M.M.
 7. With an absol. it implies duration of the action expressed by the absol.; e. g. या स्थिता व्याप्य, Which ever fills, Śāk. d. 1; Vikr. 14, 5 (परिक्रम्योपविश्य स्थित, After having walked up and down, he sits down and remains sitting).
 8. To be at hand, Man. 5, 104; Hit. 50, 21.
 9. Ātm. To stand firm, MBh. 1, 5558.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. स्थित.

 2. Standing, Chr. 17, 24.
 3. Steady, firm, immovable.

 5. Stayed, stopped.

 7. Having lived (सुखे, happily), Pañc. ii. d. 95; कथं स्थितासि, How did you do ? Vikr. 72, 6; living, Rām. 3, 53, 59.
 8. Being, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 11; Pañc. 149, 13 (एवं स्थिते, The matter being thus); Pañc. 136, 3 (लम्बमानौ यथा स्थितौ, How they hang down).
 9. Established, determined, Chr. 28, 17.
 10. Agreed, promised.

 2. A religious mendicant.
स्थण्डिलसितक स्थण्डिलसितक (cf. स्थण्डिल), n. An altar.
स्थण्डिलेशय स्थण्डिलेशय, i. e. स्थण्डिल + इ-शय, m. A devotee sleeping on a place prepared for a sacrifice, Lass. 2. ed. 49, 11.

स्थपति स्थपति, i. e. स्था, Caus., + अति, and perhaps स्थ-पति,
 I. m.
 1. An architect, Pañc. 10, 4.
 2. A carpenter, a wheelwright, Rām. 2, 63, 2, Seramp.
 3. The performer of the Vṛhaspati sacrifice, MBh. 1, 2029.
 4. A carioteer.
 5. A king or chief.
 6. A guard or attendant of the womens' apartment.
 II. adj. Chief, best.
 --Comp.

स्थपुट स्थपुट, adj.
 1. Distressed.
 2. Bent with pain, Mālat. 78, 17.

† स्थल् स्थल् (akin to स्था, cf. the next), i. 1, Par. To stand or be firm.
 --Cf. O.H.G. stallan, stellan.

स्थल स्थल् + अ, or rather स्था + ल,
 I. n., and f. ली.
 1. Firm or dry ground, Hit. i. d. 89, M.M. (ल).
 2. Place, Vikr. d. 79 (लि); Pañc. 161, 15 (ल).
 II. n., and f. ला, A spot drained and raised.
 III. n.
 1. A mound, a terrace, Megh. 67.
 2. A tent.
 3. Point, topic.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. O.H.G. stal, stall; A.S. stal, stael; O.H.G. [] stullan; Goth. ga-stalds; O.H.G. stelza, stolz; also A.S. stillan, stille.

स्थाल स्था + ल,
 I. n. A plate, a dish, Rājat. 5, 46.
 II. f. ली, A pot, Pañc. 262, 16.
स्थलकमल स्थल-कमल, n., and -कमलिनी, f. A shrub, Hibiscus mutabilis, Megh. 90.

स्थलज स्थल-ज, adj.
 1. Growing on earth, Man. 6, 13.
 2. Terrestrial.
स्थलता स्थल + ता, in शुष्क-स्थल + ता, f. Dryness, Pañc. 84, 19; 79, 13.
स्थलेशय स्थलेशय, i. e. स्थल + इ-शय, m. An amphibious animal.
स्थवि स्थवि, probably vb. स्था (see the next), m. A weaver.

स्थविर स्थविर, probably for स्थावर, cf. स्थाविर,
 I. adj., f. रा.
 1. Fixed, firm.
 2. Old, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 12.
 II. m.
 1. An old man.
 2. A beggar.
 3. Brahman.
स्थाविर स्थाविर, i. e. स्था + वन् + अ, with इ for अ, and र् for न्, n. Old age, Man. 9, 3 (adj. Old, Hit. i. d. 119, M.M.; but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1774).
स्थविष्ठ स्थविष्ठ, स्थवीयंस् स्थवीयंस्, see स्थूल.

स्थाणु स्थाणु (vb. स्था),
 I. adj. Firm, steady, fixed, immovable, Chr. 46, 20; MBh. 1, 7291.
 II. m. and n. The trunk of a tree, Man. 9, 44; Bhāṣāp. 128.
 III. m.
 1. A stake, a post, Pañc. i. d. 55.
 2. A spear.
 3. A nest of white ants.
 4. Śiva, Vikr. d. 1; Rām. 3, 53, 60.
स्थाणुवत् स्थाणु + वत्, adv. Like a post, Pañc. i. d. 55.

स्थातृ स्था + तृ, m., f. त्री, and n. Who or what stands.
 --Cf. Lat. stator.

स्थान स्थान, i. e. स्था + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Staying, Lass. 28, 10; stay, state, Utt. Rāmac. 51, 5; Man. 7, 56 (forces); position, Hit. i. d. 51, M.M.
 2. Middle state, as neither loss nor gain (equality), calmness, Rām. 3, 52, 2 (corr. नहि मे जीवितं स्थाने, My life, i. e. my whole being, is disquieted).
 3. Firmness of troops.
 4. Keeping in array.
 5. Halt.
 6. Place, Pañc. 133, 5; 37, 8; a holy place, Chr. 46, 26; the right place, Hit. ii. d. 70.
 7. Country, Hit. i. d. 169, M.M.
 8. An altar, Vikr. d. 43.
 9. An open place in a town.
 10. A dwelling-place, Hit. iii. d. 5; house, Chr. 60, 37; Śṛṅgārat. 11.
 11. A town.
 12. Office, Rājat. 5, 297.
 13. The part of an actor, Vikr. 3, 9.
 14. Degree, rank, Hit. i. d. 168, M.M.
 15. Object, Man. 2, 136; Pañc. 82, 12.
 16. Likeness.
 17. Intimation (cf. स्थानक), Lass. 7, 5.
 18. Interval.
 II. loc. ने, adv.
 1. Fitly, properly, justly, Vikr. 8, 16; in the right moment, Śāk. 37, 34.
 2. Sometimes, MBh. 1, 6845.
 3. Because.
 4. Instead, Pañc. 37, 21.
 5. Like, as, Pañc. 52, 1; 55, 22.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. δύστηνος (i. e. δυσ-στηνος), ἄ-στηνος, ἀ-στήν, ἀσταίνω, δυσταίνω.

स्थानक स्थान + क, n.
 1. A town.
 2. A basin of water at the root of a tree,
 3. A bubble on spirits or wine.
 4. A kind of speaking (addressing ?), Vikr. 64, 21.
 --Comp.
स्थानासनविहारवन्त् स्थानासनविहारवन्त्, adj. स्थान-आसन-विहार + वन्त्, adj. Occupying the station, seat, and place of religious exercises (of his preceptor), Man. 2, 248.

स्थानिक स्थानिक, i. e. स्थान + इक,
 I. adj. Local.
 II. m. The governor of a place.
स्थानिन् स्थानिन्, i. e. स्थान + इन्, adj. Having a place or situation, permanent.

स्थानीय स्थानीय, i. e. स्थान + ईय,
 I. adj. Relating or suitable to any place.
 II. n. A city.
 --Comp.

स्थापक स्थापक, i. e. स्था, Caus., + अक,
 I. adj. Causing to stand, placing, fixing, ordering.
 II. m.
 1. A stage manager.
 2. The founder of a temple.
 --Comp.

स्थापत्य स्थापत्य, i. e. स्थपति + य,
 I. m. A guard of the womens' apartments.
 II. n. Architecture, building, erecting, Rām. 1, 12, 6.

स्थापन स्थापन, i. e. स्था, Caus., + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Placing, Naiṣ. 22, 45, Sch.; fixing, erecting, founding.
 2. Concentrating one's thoughts upon the object of meditation.
 3. Ordering.
 4. A habitation.
 5. A ceremony performed when the mother perceives the first signs of living conception.
 II. f. ना, Stage management.
 III. f. नी, A plant, Cissampelos hexandra.
स्थामन् स्था + मन्, n. Strength, power.

स्थायिन् स्थायिन्, i. e. स्था + इन्, adj., f. नी,
 1. Staying, lasting, Hit. i. d. 48, M.M.
 2. Firm, steady, unchangeable, Pañc. i. d. 39.
 --Comp.

स्थायुक स्थायुक, i. e. स्था + उक,
 I. adj. Steady, stationary.
 II. m. The overseer of a village.

स्थावर स्था + वर (i. e. वन् + अ, with र् for न्).
 I. adj.
 1. Fixed, stable, immovable, Man. 1, 40; 41; 5, 28.
 2. [] Stationary (guards), Man. 9, 266.
 3. Established, regular.
 II. m. A mountain, Bhag. 10, 25.
 III. n.
 1. A bowstring.
 2. Real estate.
 3. A heirloom.
स्थावरता स्थावर + ता, f. Immobility, Man. 12, 9 (a vegetable or mineral form).

स्थासक स्थासक (vb. स्था), m.
 1. A bubble of any fluid (cf. स्थानक).
 2. Smearing the body with fragrant unguents.
स्थासु स्थासु, vb. स्था, n. Bodily strength or capability.

स्थास्नु स्था + स्नु, adj.
 1. Firm, immovable, Man. 1, 56.
 2. Durable, eternal, Kir. 2, 19.
